changelog: Full-length trailers (no more 60s cut, better source quality, no looping client-side); Warm Orca trailer cache is now a real Jellyfin scheduled task (Dashboard > Scheduled Tasks, default every 60h, trigger user-editable); genuine LLM Because You Watched picks (Groq) with why-blurbs when configured; the ... to Request rows are folded back into a single Worth Requesting row; plugin now reports its real version (assembly version was stuck at 1.0.0.0).
description: Server-side intelligence engine for the Orca X TV app: personalization, recommendations, caching, and centralized administration.
name: Orca Engine
overview: The brain/backbone for the Orca X Android TV client.
